opportunity: Long-form creators with a repurposing backlog
target_signals: Weekly podcast or long-form YouTube; many episodes; limited short-form clips; content archive; clips/posting irregularity.
why_now: The product's stated value proposition explicitly converts long-form recordings and back catalogs into short-form assets.
message_angle: One recording can support a week of clips and posts without manually rebuilding each asset.
evidence_needed_per_lead: Official channel/profile, recent long-form posts, public commercial offer, visible repurposing/workflow evidence, public business contact channel active in last 60 days.

opportunity: Expert-led creators with a monetised offer
target_signals: Coach, consultant, educator or founder who publishes videos/podcasts and sells coaching, courses, consulting, membership or services.
why_now: Their content has a direct business purpose: audience growth and lead generation. Public offer evidence gives a stronger commercial qualification signal than follower count alone.
message_angle: Turn existing expertise into consistent content that supports the offer they already sell.
evidence_needed_per_lead: Official creator profile, explicit course/service/booking/membership/sponsorship evidence, active content, specific recent content reference, business contact channel.

target_signals: Active on 2+ relevant platforms; different formats per platform; irregular cadence or manual cross-posting signals.
why_now: IncuBrix positions cross-platform formatting and publishing as a way to reduce tab switching and repetitive work.
message_angle: Reduce the number of separate steps between recording and publishing across platforms.
evidence_needed_per_lead: Official profile URLs on multiple platforms, recent activity, public commercial offer, concrete workflow friction signal, verified public contact channel.
